latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Instantly turn static AI images into 1080p animated MP4 videos via cloud rendering.

- Upload character illustrations or portraits (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, up to 20MB) and convert them to video in seconds.
- No manual animation skills required — simply describe the desired animation, and the backend handles the rest.
- Automated session, authentication, and credits flow with clear error handling and feedback.
- Supports export, credits check, file upload, and live session state tracking.
- Includes tips, prompt suggestions, and detailed guides for quick or iterative edits.
